en.text: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

zhSimplified.text: 拿玛人琐法回答说：

zhTraditional.text: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：

en.text: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

zhSimplified.text: 我心中急躁， 所以我的思念叫我回答。

zhTraditional.text: 我心中急躁， 所以我的思念叫我回答。

en.text: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

zhSimplified.text: 我已听见那羞辱我，责备我的话； 我的悟性叫我回答。

zhTraditional.text: 我已聽見那羞辱我，責備我的話； 我的悟性叫我回答。

en.text: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

zhSimplified.text: 你岂不知亘古以来， 自从人生在地，

zhTraditional.text: 你豈不知亙古以來， 自從人生在地，

en.text: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

zhSimplified.text: 恶人夸胜是暂时的， 不敬虔人的喜乐不过转眼之间吗？

zhTraditional.text: 惡人誇勝是暫時的， 不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間嗎？

en.text: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

zhSimplified.text: 他的尊荣虽达到天上， 头虽顶到云中，

zhTraditional.text: 他的尊榮雖達到天上， 頭雖頂到雲中，

en.text: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

zhSimplified.text: 他终必灭亡，像自己的粪一样； 素来见他的人要说：他在哪里呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他終必滅亡，像自己的糞一樣； 素來見他的人要說：他在哪裏呢？

en.text: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

zhSimplified.text: 他必飞去如梦，不再寻见， 速被赶去，如夜间的异象。

zhTraditional.text: 他必飛去如夢，不再尋見， 速被趕去，如夜間的異象。

en.text: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

zhSimplified.text: 亲眼见过他的，必不再见他； 他的本处也再见不着他。

zhTraditional.text: 親眼見過他的，必不再見他； 他的本處也再見不着他。

en.text: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

zhSimplified.text: 他的儿女要求穷人的恩； 他的手要赔还不义之财。

zhTraditional.text: 他的兒女要求窮人的恩； 他的手要賠還不義之財。

en.text: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

zhSimplified.text: 他的骨头虽然有青年之力， 却要和他一同躺卧在尘土中。

zhTraditional.text: 他的骨頭雖然有青年之力， 卻要和他一同躺臥在塵土中。

en.text: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

zhSimplified.text: 他口内虽以恶为甘甜， 藏在舌头底下，

zhTraditional.text: 他口內雖以惡為甘甜， 藏在舌頭底下，

en.text: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

zhSimplified.text: 爱恋不舍，含在口中；

zhTraditional.text: 愛戀不捨，含在口中；

en.text: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

zhSimplified.text: 他的食物在肚里却要化为酸， 在他里面成为虺蛇的恶毒。

zhTraditional.text: 他的食物在肚裏卻要化為酸， 在他裏面成為虺蛇的惡毒。

en.text: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

zhSimplified.text: 他吞了财宝，还要吐出； 神要从他腹中掏出来。

zhTraditional.text: 他吞了財寶，還要吐出； 上帝要從他腹中掏出來。

en.text: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

zhSimplified.text: 他必吸饮虺蛇的毒气； 蝮蛇的舌头也必杀他。

zhTraditional.text: 他必吸飲虺蛇的毒氣； 蝮蛇的舌頭也必殺他。

en.text: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

zhSimplified.text: 流奶与蜜之河， 他不得再见。

zhTraditional.text: 流奶與蜜之河， 他不得再見。

en.text: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

zhSimplified.text: 他劳碌得来的要赔还，不得享用； 不能照所得的财货欢乐。

zhTraditional.text: 他勞碌得來的要賠還，不得享用； 不能照所得的財貨歡樂。

en.text: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

zhSimplified.text: 他欺压穷人，且又离弃； 强取非自己所盖的房屋 。

footnotes.text: - 20:19 或译：强取房屋不得再建造

zhTraditional.text: 他欺壓窮人，且又離棄； 強取非自己所蓋的房屋。

footnotes.text: - 20:19 或譯：強取房屋不得再建造

en.text: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

zhSimplified.text: 他因贪而无厌， 所喜悦的连一样也不能保守。

zhTraditional.text: 他因貪而無厭， 所喜悅的連一樣也不能保守。

en.text: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的没有一样他不吞灭， 所以他的福乐不能长久。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的沒有一樣他不吞滅， 所以他的福樂不能長久。

en.text: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

zhSimplified.text: 他在满足有余的时候，必到狭窄的地步； 凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他在滿足有餘的時候，必到狹窄的地步； 凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。

en.text: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

zhSimplified.text: 他正要充满肚腹的时候， 神必将猛烈的忿怒降在他身上； 正在他吃饭的时候， 要将这忿怒像雨降在他身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他正要充滿肚腹的時候， 上帝必將猛烈的忿怒降在他身上； 正在他吃飯的時候， 要將這忿怒像雨降在他身上。

en.text: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

zhSimplified.text: 他要躲避铁器； 铜弓的箭要将他射透。

zhTraditional.text: 他要躲避鐵器； 銅弓的箭要將他射透。

en.text: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

zhSimplified.text: 他把箭一抽，就从他身上出来； 发光的箭头从他胆中出来， 有惊惶临在他身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他把箭一抽，就從他身上出來； 發光的箭頭從他膽中出來， 有驚惶臨在他身上。

en.text: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

zhSimplified.text: 他的财宝归于黑暗； 人所不吹的火要把他烧灭， 要把他帐棚中所剩下的烧毁。

zhTraditional.text: 他的財寶歸於黑暗； 人所不吹的火要把他燒滅， 要把他帳棚中所剩下的燒毀。

en.text: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

zhSimplified.text: 天要显明他的罪孽； 地要兴起攻击他。

zhTraditional.text: 天要顯明他的罪孽； 地要興起攻擊他。

en.text: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 他的家产必然过去； 神发怒的日子，他的货物都要消灭。

zhTraditional.text: 他的家產必然過去； 上帝發怒的日子，他的貨物都要消滅。

en.text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

zhSimplified.text: 这是恶人从 神所得的分， 是 神为他所定的产业。

zhTraditional.text: 這是惡人從上帝所得的分， 是上帝為他所定的產業。
